critical_code_review_comments: strategic_goals.py L99: sort by target_date asc looks right but stores target_date as a free-string ('2026-12' or 'Q4 2026') — string sort works for YYYY-MM but mixed formats ('Q4 2026' vs '2026-12') won't sort meaningfully. Acceptable for MVP; consider normalizing to ISO month later.

strategic_goals.py L216: 502 raised when LLM returns no parseable goals. Frontend ExtractFromDocModal surfaces the message via toast — good. Consider a friendlier UX message ('AKKI couldn't find board-level goals; try a richer doc.').

Monitor.jsx L47-52: deriveFunction silently falls back to 'ceo' if account.preferences.executive_function is unset — an exec who hasn't picked a function will see CEO view by default with no nudge. The Pencil/'change' affordance is the only nudge; consider an inline banner the first time. Not blocking.

StrategicGoalsPanel.jsx L40-45: visibleGoalsForFunction adds 'board' + 'ceo' to every non-CEO function's allow-set (cross-cutting concept is fine), but a CFO whose own department has 0 goals will still see CEO/Board goals — clarify in copy that 'On your function's plate' includes cross-cutting items.

strategic_goals.py L177-216: extract-from-doc uses an 18k-char sample and trusts LLM to mark department; valid_departments fallback to 'ceo' silently — good defensive parse. The 90s frontend timeout aligns with possible LLM latency.

PATCH /accounts/me preferences merge: must not blow away other preference keys. Verified by patching CFO→CEO→COO→Commercial→CFO sequentially — the executive_function key updates and other keys remain (no regression observed).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (Monitor exec + NED scorecard + FunctionPickerModal save + Landing testids + Learn compact grid all verified live)

seed_data_creation: Created and deleted one TEST_ goal on Tuli CFO context during the test; pre-existing 'Migrate to new ERP by Dec 2026' seed used for UI verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login URL is /signin. After login, default ctx is Tuli CFO (executive). To reach NED scorecard: click 'NED' in role-switcher, then click 'Mawingu Logistics' in portfolio rail. test_iter28_strategic_goals.py covers all CRUD + extract 404 + clamp + accounts.me preferences round-trip. The 400-path for extract (doc with no extracted_text) is currently SKIPPED because no doc with extracted_chars=0 exists on the Tuli CFO ctx — main agent can either seed a stub doc or the next agent can create one inline via direct mongo insert. The LLM extract happy-path (real call) was NOT exercised to keep tests deterministic; manual smoke via UI is recommended.
